name: sol-terra-delivery
description: Scope-sized product delivery with verified Sol planning, Terra execution and acceptance, Luna deterministic checks, persistent Program progress, runtime provenance, evidence lifecycle, and completion telemetry.

interface.shortDescription: Sol plans, Terra delivers and accepts, Luna checks.
interface.longDescription: Sizes approved work before planning, keeps one Program Goal across child milestones, verifies native spawn arguments and actual per-turn models, records runtime provenance and evidence invalidation, runs risk-driven stage user journeys, and requires an independent Terra final acceptance plus a completion-telemetry-backed raw-evidence gate.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $product-to-delivery to guide this feature from discovery through approved and verified delivery.
